description:
You are a Database Architect. A flat-table database containing real global airport data from OpenFlights has been set up at /home/ga/Documents/databases/airports_flat.db. It has a single denormalized table 'airports_raw' with columns: airport_id (INTEGER), name (TEXT), city (TEXT), country (TEXT), iata_code (TEXT), icao_code (TEXT), latitude (REAL), longitude (REAL), altitude (INTEGER), timezone_offset (REAL), dst_type (TEXT), tz_name (TEXT), type (TEXT), source (TEXT).

Your tasks:

1. Connect to the database in DBeaver with the connection name exactly 'Airports' (SQLite driver).

2. Design and create a normalized (3NF) schema in the SAME database (airports_flat.db) with these three new tables:
   - 'countries' with columns: country_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY
   - 'timezones' with columns: tz_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, timezone_offset REAL, dst_type TEXT
   - 'airports' with columns: airport_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, city TEXT, iata_code TEXT, icao_code TEXT, latitude REAL, longitude REAL, altitude INTEGER, type TEXT, source TEXT, country_name TEXT REFERENCES countries(country_name), tz_name TEXT REFERENCES timezones(tz_name)

3. Migrate all data from airports_raw into the three new tables using INSERT...SELECT statements.

4. Write a validation query that checks: (a) count of airports in the new airports table equals count in airports_raw, (b) count of distinct countries in countries table.

5. Save a validation report to /home/ga/Documents/exports/normalization_report.txt containing exactly these labeled values:
   ORIGINAL_COUNT: <number>
   AIRPORTS_TABLE_COUNT: <number>
   COUNTRIES_COUNT: <number>
   TIMEZONES_COUNT: <number>
   MIGRATION_VALID: YES or NO (YES if ORIGINAL_COUNT == AIRPORTS_TABLE_COUNT)

Login: ga / password123.
